significance: A Kerala-style temple in the Thycaud quarter of Thiruvananthapuram dedicated to Dharma Sastha, a dedication comparatively uncommon even in south India. It is administered by the Nair Service Society and keeps Mandala-Makaravilakku as its main festival, with shrines to Ganapathy, Vishnu, Shiva, Durga, Hanuman and Subramanya.
